title: KRISPY KREME® Introduces $10 Original Glazed® Clean Sheet Dozen Featuring ‘Red, White and Goooaaal’ Doughnut for America’s Match Wednesday
summary: If America delivers a “clean sheet” Wednesday, Krispy Kreme will celebrate Thursday with free Original Glazed® doughnuts nationwide Krispy Kreme® is sweetening fandom and watch parties for America’s big soccer match with a one day only $10 Original Glazed® Clean Sheet Dozen, available beginning at 5 p.m. ET / 2 p.m. PT Wednesday, featuring the all-new “Red, White and Goooaaal” Original Glazed doughnut. If America delivers a “clean sheet” Wednesday, Krispy Kreme will celebrate Thursday with free Original Glazed® doughnuts nationwide As a proud supporter of clean sheet soccer, Krispy Kreme is offering this one-day dozen with $0 delivery on Wednesday. And to boot, if America keeps its opponent off the scoreboard with a clean sheet (no goals allowed) on Wednesday, Krispy Kreme will celebrate on Thursday by offering FREE Original Glazed doughnuts all day long, limit one per guest, no purchase necessary.
